notes:
kr8 0.4.11: Everyone in a community must update to 0.4.11. Board positions are now stored in a new format, and 0.4.10 and older cannot read it: a node that a 0.4.11 member moved shows on an older desktop or phone with no position, and a position the older client writes is ignored. Neither side shows an error, so members on different versions would see different arrangements of the same board. Update every desktop and phone together.
